agent_explanation: Thin vertical wall (w=0.1) top at y=9.1; fast body (~23 m/s) grazes the top corner obliquely. Step 2 separated, step 3 slight overlap (-0.064) with velocity unchanged, step 4 deep overlap (-0.274). Face-center hit at same speed passes, so failure is corner/edge handling for thin boxes: corner contact generates no impulse/positional correction, allowing penetration to grow despite substepping (18-19 substeps).
